tests.reasoning: The description opens with imperative phrasing ('Use this skill when...'), focuses on user intent (what questions the user is asking about standards), explicitly lists trigger contexts (AV1, SCTE-35, SCTE-104, MediaPackage v2 headers) including cases where the standard isn't named ('even when the standard is not named, for example...'), and also explicitly carves out what's out of scope (file analysis, DRM). It is a bit long but remains a single focused paragraph appropriate for the breadth of the skill.
